use_case: Dynamic pricing and personalized offers: ESL markdowns, online prices within bounds, and weekly personalized digital coupons (SYS-12)
business_owner: Chief Merchandising Officer (prices and markdowns); Chief Marketing Officer (offers)
vendor_or_model: Company-built models on Cloud B with a commercial optimization library
data_categories: Loyalty purchase history (pseudonymous member ID); store cluster; delivery zone; item cost, shelf price, stock, and sales velocity
consequential_decision_category: None (prices and offers; see Tennessee note in the assessment)
human_in_the_loop: Price bounds and cost floor set by merchandising; pricing change board approves rule changes; category managers review the daily exception report
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1); 45(n)); Tennessee Act 47-18-3206(a)(3) (profiling assessment), 47-18-3203(a)(2)(E), 47-18-3204(a)(5); 7 CFR 278.2(b) (equal prices for SNAP households); Fla. Stat. 501.160 (worked example)
status: In production (112 stores for markdowns; online prices; 3.1 million members for offers)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as model inputs; delivery zone and store cluster can act as proxies for income and race
fairness_testing_status: Store cluster only; neighborhood income and delivery zone tests due 2027-01-31 (POAM-021)
monitoring: Daily exception report; monthly price index by zone and offer value ratio by income group; emergency price freeze checks

use_case: Demand forecasting and automated store replenishment
vendor_or_model: Forecasting module in the supply chain software (vendor model)
data_categories: Store sales history; promotions; weather; DC inventory
human_in_the_loop: Replenishment analysts review exceptions and override orders
monitoring: Forecast accuracy by category; out-of-stock rate

use_case: Card-not-present fraud screening for online orders
data_categories: Order, device, and payment token data; account history
consequential_decision_category: None (order declines; see Tennessee note in the assessment)
human_in_the_loop: Orders flagged for review go to the fraud team; customers can ask for manual review through customer care
tennessee_act_assessment: Not required (fraud prevention); counsel reviewing the basic necessities definition
fairness_testing_status: Decline rate by ZIP income group reviewed quarterly since 2026-Q2

use_case: Retail media audience building and closed-loop measurement in the clean room (SL-1)
vendor_or_model: Clean room software with company-built audience models on Cloud B
data_categories: Pseudonymous member basket data; CPG client first-party data inside the clean room; aggregated outputs
human_in_the_loop: Retail media analysts approve each audience and report template; outputs aggregated with minimum audience thresholds
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1); 45(n)); Tennessee Act 47-18-3206(a)(1) (targeted advertising assessment), 47-18-3204(d) (disclosure and opt-out); Visa Core Rules 1.9.4.2 (contractual)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None; sensitive segments (health conditions inferred from purchases) prohibited
fairness_testing_status: Not applicable (no decision about individuals); segment rules reviewed by the Privacy Office
monitoring: Threshold enforcement by template; audience requests reviewed weekly

use_case: Self-checkout computer vision that detects missed scans and alerts the attendant
vendor_or_model: Self-checkout vendor vision model (no facial recognition)
data_categories: Overhead camera video of the bagging area (not kept after 72 hours unless an alert is reviewed); item scans
human_in_the_loop: Alerts go only to the attendant, who offers help; staff guidance is "assist, never accuse"; no alert is used for a stop or ban
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); board prohibition on facial recognition
tennessee_act_assessment: To be decided in the committee review
fairness_testing_status: Not started; false alert rate by store and time of day to be measured
monitoring: Monthly false alert rate by store

use_case: Customer service virtual assistant (generative) for order status, refunds, and store information
vendor_or_model: Generative AI service from Cloud B under enterprise terms (no training on company data)
data_categories: Customer questions; order status; account data after sign-in
human_in_the_loop: Refunds above the auto-approve limit, allergen, and health questions go to agents; customers can ask for an agent at any time
fairness_testing_status: Not applicable; monthly answer quality sample
monitoring: Monthly sample of 200 conversations; incorrect answer rate

monitoring: Schedule edits by managers; hours distribution
